title: Invalid provisional bilateral H2/HS network attempt
source_state: Previously uncommitted working-tree implementation; archived with only INVALID docstring labels added and no logic changes.
question_attempted: Can a bilateral T4-derived H2/HS network enhance DNp15 yaw-like versus translation-like selectivity?
why_invalid: The electrical term was implemented as positive recurrent input g * W_gap * state, not diffusive conductance proportional to the paired state difference.
Equal LPTC states produced a nonzero electrical current vector instead of zero.
The literature matrix connected contralateral H2 to HSE, HSN, and HSS generically rather than retaining only pairings supported by cited primary literature.
The combined chemical-plus-electrical LPTC feedback block had raw spectral radius 1.25 and effective Euler transition spectral radius 1.00125.
A zero-input deterministic perturbation grew instead of decaying.
The model did not reproduce a yaw-like versus translation-like hierarchy; the reported mean DNp15 bilateral-difference-area ratio was effectively 1.0.

uninterpretable_generated_result.interpretation: No biological inference is permitted because preflight failed.

generated_outputs: Ignored local results/exp004 and data/malecns_exp004_binocular_network; not public evidence.
successor_rule: A future EXP-004 must be a new implementation with controlled upstream HS/H2 inputs, exact interaction provenance, diffusive electrical semantics, effective-transition stability, zero-input decay, deterministic tests, and quantitative physiology targets before interpretation.
